name: offline-business-validation-v1

primary.success_rule: Paired whole-user bootstrap 95% interval lower bound must exceed zero. A pass supports this logged-label proxy in this previously used development cohort, not causal online CTR or revenue lift.

eligibility: All impressions with at least two observed candidates, including zero-click and all-click groups. Never condition the main denominator on a click. Contiguous-rank sensitivity means observed ranks equal 1..n, not a guarantee of complete logging.
ties: Primary outcomes integrate uniformly over exact score ties. The uniform baseline equals context-only ranking. Separately report product-ID tie breaking for seed 42 and the ID-only baseline; no best-seed or best-tie-rule selection.
aggregation: Average per-request outcomes over the three frozen seeds, then compute request-weighted estimates and paired whole-user bootstrap intervals. This averages trained-model outcomes, not scores into a new ensemble. Secondary contrasts and slices are exploratory, without multiplicity adjustment.
business_mapping: Count how many historically clicked ads a fixed one-slot or three-slot selection captures, per 1000 requests. Also report fraction of observed clicks captured. These are offline observed-label selection proxies, NOT deployed CTR, incremental clicks, conversions, or revenue.
no_tuning: Freeze existing weights, alpha and candidates. No retraining, coefficient search, original test access, automatic promotion, inferred propensities, IPS/DR, CPC assumptions or currency-valued lift.
limitations: Previously used development validation. Public logs are non-uniformly subsampled; candidate sets may be incomplete; click labels arose at historical positions. Randomized display order helps reduce position confounding but does not restore missing sampling or logging probabilities. Candidate selection and inter-ad interference remain. Confidence intervals condition on the fixed models and sampled cohort.
